liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Sugaree was rated pretty hot, the show's standout in this reviewer's view; Sugaree ran about 14 minutes and is singled out as excellent [9][12]
- **Easy Answers** (2 reviews): Easy Answers was slyly tucked into the middle of The Music Never Stopped; Easy Answers was played badly, and the reviewer enjoyed the butchering [13][14]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue was sloppy, with tempo confusion; Jerry never sang the line about making them shine [12]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Easy Answers [20]

## The recordings

- **gd93-06-05.sbd.wiley.8328.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard sound superb; Soundboard sounds crisp and beefy, rated top marks throughout [10][12]
- **gd93-06-05.aud.wiley.8041.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 175 min; rated 2.14/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has the mic far from the stage, with crowd noise louder than the music [15]
- **gd1993-06-05.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.104982.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1993-06-05.149527.fob.sennheiserMKH40.ebel.flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 173 min [4]

## Around the show

- A recorded Mickey message before the opener warned fans against crashing the floor as the year before, or the band risked a Giants Stadium ban [8]
- Reviewer saw yellowjackets chase a hesher into the men's room and drag him out kicking and screaming [8]
- Recalls a message from Phil saying you can't dance with a broken ankle, so fans shouldn't jump the wall [9]
- Mickey's pre-recorded warning about crashing the floor was shown several times on the big screens [11]
- Weather on this first day of the run was poor [11]
- Jerry had equipment trouble, tried fixing it before the first set, and swapped guitars at some point [11]
- A video message from Mickey begged the crowd not to jump the wall, since you can't dance with a broken leg [17]
- First set was great by 1993 standards [13]
- Second set started well, but energy was gone after Fire on the Mountain [13]
- Easy Answers turns up nearly every other night, unlike other songs that could have been revived [14]
- First set, apart from Easy Answers, is particularly strong for 1993 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-06-05.sbd.wiley.8328.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSDB master> DAT Clone> ?> CDR [1]. Also: Source is a DSDB master, cloned to DAT, then an unknown step to CDR; seeded to etree by Tim Wiley [1]
- **gd93-06-05.aud.wiley.8041.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Tim W. and Paul B.; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [2]
- **gd1993-06-05.nak300.carpenter.andrewf.104982.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MXS 90/100, set up back of floor. [3]
- **gd1993-06-05.149527.fob.sennheiserMKH40.ebel.flac1648**: transferred by Transfers by Pete Ebel March 10, 2019; source: FOB Sennheiser MKH-40 (Wide-Angled Cardioid)-> DAT [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 5, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-5-1993) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 6, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-6-1993) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 6, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-6-1993) [23]
